TD is the tympanum, not the eye, so sensory_anatomy stands. Table 3 columns: Characters | Abbreviation | Holotype | Paratype | Mean ± SD, with specimen codes JnUZool-A0419, JnUZool-A0319, JnUZool-A0519, JnUZool-A0619 in that order (the paper prints one code with a space, 'JnUZool- A0519'); the quote is the whole printed row 5 with cells joined by single spaces, abbreviation in the short form (the page reader renders 'TD (tympanum diameter)'); the specimen is the column read, cell mapping is the WebFetch page reader's reading of the Pensoft preview (two reads gave the same cells). The row labelled 'TD (tympanum diameter) I' to 'V' (rows 30-34) are toe-disc widths and are not filed. The Description of holotype also prints 'Tympanum indistinct, oval (TD (tympanum diameter) = 1.10), close to eye' (agrees with the table). All four specimens are adult males per desk-d610.
